verdict.rationale: Brex documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants act on a Brex account in natural language: managing expenses, looking up users, checking cards, reviewing banking transactions and tracking bills (brex-docs-3, brex-docs-24, brex-probe-3). Its marketing also describes AI assistants that do employees' expenses for them (brex-docs-23). missing for 10: evidence of a native in-product natural-language command interface (rather than via external AI assistants), detail on which write actions the MCP server supports, independent or hands-on corroboration.
